name: IBAN 国际银行账号验证

map.请在上方输入 IBAN 以开始校验: Enter an IBAN above to start validation
map.点击国家代码可快速加载示例: Click a country code to quickly load an example
map.mod-97 校验：将 IBAN 前 4 位移至末尾，字母转数字（A=10 …: mod-97 check: move the first 4 characters to the end, convert letters to digits (A=10 … Z=35), the whole mod 97 should equal 1
map.依据 ISO 13616 的 mod-97 算法校验 IBAN 国家代码与校验位: Per ISO 13616's mod-97 algorithm, validate the IBAN country code and check digits, and check each country/region's standard IBAN length; format check only, not account authenticity.
map.1. 将 IBAN 前 4 位（国家代码 + 校验位）移到末尾；: 1. Move the first 4 characters (country code + check digits) to the end;
map.2. 将所有字母转换为数字（A=10, B=11, …, Z=35）；: 2. Convert all letters to digits (A=10, B=11, …, Z=35);
map.3. 对得到的数字串执行 mod 97 运算；: 3. Apply the mod 97 operation to the resulting digit string;
map.4. 若结果为 1，则 IBAN 校验通过。: 4. If the result is 1, the IBAN passes validation.
map.IBAN 不区分大小写，标准格式为每 4 字符空格分隔，最多 34 个字符。中国: IBAN is case-insensitive, standard format is space-separated every 4 characters, up to 34 characters. China does not currently use the IBAN system.
map.校验国际银行账号 IBAN 格式与校验位: Validate the IBAN format and check digits
map.识别国家码与 BBAN 结构: Identify the country code and BBAN structure
map.IBAN = 国别码(2 字母)+ 校验位(2 数字)+ 本国账号 BBAN。如: IBAN = country code (2 letters) + check digits (2 numbers) + domestic account BBAN. E.g. DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00: DE Germany, 89 check digits, followed by the German account.
map.把 IBAN 循环左移（校验位移至末尾），字母转数字（A=10…Z=35），整体: Cyclically left-shift the IBAN (move check digits to the end), convert letters to digits (A=10…Z=35), take mod 97 of the whole; result 1 means valid. It catches most input errors.
map.IBAN 和账号关系？: What is the relationship between IBAN and an account number?
map.IBAN 是在本国账号(BBAN)前加国码与校验位的标准化形式，便于跨国自动校验: IBAN is a standardized form adding the country code and check digits before the domestic account (BBAN), easing cross-border automatic routing; domestically the local account is still used.
map.校验通过就一定能汇款吗？: Does passing validation guarantee a successful transfer?
map.通过仅说明格式与校验位正确；能否到账还取决于账户真实存在、行号有效及收款行政策，: Passing only means the format and check digits are correct; whether funds arrive also depends on the account really existing, the bank code being valid, and the recipient bank's policy; for large amounts, try a small test transfer first.
